cases.question: How many Dáil terms are linked to Mary Lou McDonald's recorded memberships?
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?term WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?person a a:Member; f:name "Mary Lou McDonald". } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?g), "https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/member/")) GRAPH ?g {?person m:hasMembersMembership ?ms. ?ms a m:DailMembership; m:inHouseTerm ?term.} GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/houses> {?term a a:DailTerm.} } ORDER BY ?term

cases.question: Give the House-owned seat total for Dáil number 33.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?seats WHERE { GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/houses> {<https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/33> a a:DailTerm; a:seats ?seats.} } ORDER BY ?seats

cases.question: Identify the Dáil terms that existed in July 2002.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?term ?label ?start ?end WHERE { GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/houses> {?term a a:DailTerm; s:prefLabel ?label; dct:temporal ?period. ?period dcat:startDate ?start. OPTIONAL {?period dcat:endDate ?end.} } FILTER(SUBSTR(STR(?start),1,10) <= "2002-07-31" && (!BOUND(?end) || SUBSTR(STR(?end),1,10) >= "2002-07-01")) } ORDER BY ?term ?label ?start ?end

cases.question: Give the recorded parties for Dáil number 29, excluding parliamentary groups.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

cases.question: Give Fine Gael representatives for either Clare or Carlow-Kilkenny in Dáil 33.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?name WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?person a a:Member; f:name ?name; m:hasMembersMembership ?membership. ?membership a m:DailMembership; m:inHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/33>; m:isRepresentativeFrom ?constituency. } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?g), "https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/member/")) GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/constituencies> { ?constituency m:constituencyInHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/33>; s:prefLabel ?constituencyLabel. VALUES ?constituencyLabel { "Clare"@en "Carlow-Kilkenny"@en } } GRAPH ?g { ?person m:hasMembersMembership ?episode. ?episode a m:PartyMembership; m:inOireachtasMembership ?membership; m:isPartyMembershipOf ?party. } GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/parties> {?party a m:ParliamentaryParty; m:activeDuringTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/33>.} GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/political-affiliations/identities> { ?party m:hasPoliticalAffiliationIdentity ?affiliation. ?affiliation a m:PoliticalAffiliationIdentity; s:prefLabel "Fine Gael"@en. } GRAPH ?g { ?membership m:hasMembershipDateRange ?membershipRange. ?membershipRange m:StartDate ?ms. OPTIONAL { ?membershipRange m:EndDate ?me. } } GRAPH ?g { ?episode m:hasMembershipDateRange ?episodeRange. ?episodeRange m:StartDate ?ps. OPTIONAL { ?episodeRange m:EndDate ?pe. } } FILTER((!BOUND(?me) || ?ps <= ?me) && (!BOUND(?pe) || ?ms <= ?pe))  } ORDER BY ?person ?name

cases.question: Count the other deputies who shared Róisín Shortall's constituency in Dáil 31.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?name WHERE { GRAPH ?ag { ?anchor a a:Member; f:name "Róisín Shortall". } FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?ag), "https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/member/")) GRAPH ?ag { ?anchor m:hasMembersMembership ?am. ?am a m:DailMembership; m:inHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/31>. } GRAPH ?ag {?am m:isRepresentativeFrom ?constituency.} GRAPH ?g {?person a a:Member; f:name ?name; m:hasMembersMembership ?membership. ?membership a m:DailMembership; m:inHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/31>; m:isRepresentativeFrom ?constituency.} GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/constituencies> {?constituency m:constituencyInHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/31>.} FILTER(?person != ?anchor)  } ORDER BY ?person ?name

cases.question: Which Members have recorded service in both this Dáil and this Seanad? The membership periods need not overlap.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?name ?ds ?de ?ss ?se WHERE { GRAPH ?g {?person a a:Member; f:name ?name.}GRAPH ?g { ?person m:hasMembersMembership ?dm. ?dm a m:DailMembership; m:inHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/dail/34>. } GRAPH ?g { ?person m:hasMembersMembership ?sm. ?sm a m:SeanadMembership; m:inHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/seanad/27>. } GRAPH ?g { ?dm m:hasMembershipDateRange ?dmRange. ?dmRange m:StartDate ?ds. OPTIONAL { ?dmRange m:EndDate ?de. } } GRAPH ?g { ?sm m:hasMembershipDateRange ?smRange. ?smRange m:StartDate ?ss. OPTIONAL { ?smRange m:EndDate ?se. } }  } ORDER BY ?person ?name ?ds ?de ?ss ?se

cases.question: Show the Fine Gael Senators who serve now.
cases.evidence_query:
PREFIX a: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology#>
PREFIX m: <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ontology/members#>
PREFIX f: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX s: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcat: <http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX dl: <http://data.europa.eu/eli/eli-draft-legislation-ontology#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?person ?name WHERE { GRAPH ?g {?person a a:Member; f:name ?name.}GRAPH ?g { ?person m:hasMembersMembership ?membership. ?membership a m:SeanadMembership; m:inHouseTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/seanad/27>. } GRAPH ?g { ?person m:hasMembersMembership ?episode. ?episode a m:PartyMembership; m:inOireachtasMembership ?membership; m:isPartyMembershipOf ?party. } GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/parties> {?party a m:ParliamentaryParty; m:activeDuringTerm <https://data.oireachtas.ie/ie/oireachtas/house/seanad/27>.} GRAPH <https://data.oireachtas.ie/graph/political-affiliations/identities> { ?party m:hasPoliticalAffiliationIdentity ?affiliation. ?affiliation a m:PoliticalAffiliationIdentity; s:prefLabel "Fine Gael"@en. } GRAPH ?g { ?membership m:hasMembershipDateRange ?membershipRange. ?membershipRange m:StartDate ?ms. OPTIONAL { ?membershipRange m:EndDate ?me. } } GRAPH ?g { ?episode m:hasMembershipDateRange ?episodeRange. ?episodeRange m:StartDate ?ps. OPTIONAL { ?episodeRange m:EndDate ?pe. } } FILTER((!BOUND(?me) || ?ps <= ?me) && (!BOUND(?pe) || ?ms <= ?pe)) FILTER(SUBSTR(STR(?ms),1,10) <= "2026-11-06" && (!BOUND(?me) || SUBSTR(STR(?me),1,10) >= "2026-11-06")) FILTER(SUBSTR(STR(?ps),1,10) <= "2026-11-06" && (!BOUND(?pe) || SUBSTR(STR(?pe),1,10) >= "2026-11-06"))  } ORDER BY ?person ?name
